We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_6_lvl2-template_search-1 to the given molecule. The template search result gave mapped_rxn and template_id 1014069. We need to apply that template to the molecule (target) to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with molecule SMILES and template_id.

We have initial_molecule SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need to apply template_id "template_1014069"? The template_id given is numeric 1014069. The tool expects string like "template_123". So we need to format as "template_1014069". Use apply_template.

Let's call apply_template.
